name: WorkingWindow start_local and end_local must be strict HH:MM or HH:MM:SS wall times with start_local strictly before end_local.

payload.rationale: WorkingWindow start_local and end_local must be strict HH:MM or HH:MM:SS wall times with start_local strictly before end_local.

response.expression: ((len(self.start_local) in [5, 8]) and (len(self.end_local) in [5, 8])) and (resolve_local_timestamp('2026-01-01T' + take(take(self.start_local, 8) + ':00', 8), 'UTC', 'reject') < resolve_local_timestamp('2026-01-01T' + take(take(self.end_local, 8) + ':00', 8), 'UTC', 'reject'))

payload.subject: time.WorkingWindow
